_comment: Frozen per-character visual identity for the Wuxia/Martial Peak channel. master_token is PREPENDED to any FLUX still whose prompt names the character (or an alias); negative_token is merged into that shot's negative. This locks age/hair/clothes/build across every episode on a CF-schnell flow that has no IP-Adapter/FaceID (prompt-lock only — reduces drift, not pixel-perfect). Style = 3D Donghua CGI realism (Wu Dong Qian Kun / Battle Through the Heavens register), NOT flat 2D.
_style_lock: cinematic 3D Chinese donghua CGI, Wu Dong Qian Kun / Battle Through the Heavens style, Unreal-Engine-quality realistic rendering, dramatic volumetric atmospheric lighting, richly textured silk robes, mature serious tone, intricate detail, sharp focus, epic 16:9 landscape, 4k, masterpiece
_global_negative: 2D, flat cartoon, anime cel-shaded, flat coloring, comic book, chibi, toddler, child proportions, cute, watermark, text, chinese characters, japanese text, calligraphy, logo, emblem, seal, stamp, signature, username, subtitle, caption, title card, engraved text on rocks, poster text, blurry, low quality, deformed hands, extra fingers, jpeg artifacts, oversaturated, portrait, vertical crop

_comment_compact: compact_token = short identity descriptor used INSTEAD of master_token when 2+ registry characters appear in one shot — two full tokens + style lock would exceed FLUX's ~1000-char effective window (prompt-budget amputation).

still_structure: scene declaration + atmosphere in one clause
ONE focal object with a story (e.g. 'a lone banner hanging by a thread')
_prompt_template.quality_suffix: cinematic ultra-detailed lighting, hyper-detailed ground textures, natural debris, high-definition micro-details, lifelike dust particles floating, zero smoothing
_prompt_template.video_prompt_rule: derive motion prompt FROM the finished still (vision-describe it), never from the scene concept
av_sync_rules: hook = dead silence + wind + cloth flutter only
sudden bass drop ON the reveal shot, not on the cut
sound events tie to narrative beats, not just cuts
